{{Top}}
A '''portable heater''' was a thin square of specially formulated [[Ceramic/Legends|ceramic]]. It generated enough heat to keep a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] alive within a three [[Cubic meter/Legends|cubic meter]] enclosed area in temperatures as low as -75 degrees Celsius for several [[Standard day/Legends|days]], with the possibility of lasting a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] or two with sufficient regulation.
